lede: AF & CARS is a car workshop in Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub. Its own website lists air conditioning service, brake service, engine repair and accident repair.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention lower prices than a large chain, advice to keep parts still in good condition and friendly service. One customer described a dispute over a rental hybrid car.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, afcars.com.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
